name: ARBORVERSITY

goods.text: Educational services, namely, providing online courses, virtual curriculum, live training, job aids, and educational experiences in the fields of horticulture, arboriculture, public horticulture, environmental education, public garden management, and professional development; Providing online, non-downloadable educational videos, interactive activities, lesson plans, job aids, and other educational materials in the fields of horticulture, arboriculture, public horticulture, environmental education, public garden management, and professional development.
